span.label: mechanisms
span.term: BENEFIT OUTWEIGHS COST RATHER THAN COST DETERRING: technology acceptance in older adults tracks the perceived benefit more than the perceived price, which the paper reads through diffusion of innovations - adoption follows a clear benefit being visible
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: EAGERNESS AND LOW CONFIDENCE COEXIST: most participants wanted to adopt the technology and the majority simultaneously doubted their own ability to use it, so the obstacle reported is instruction rather than motivation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A CATEGORY CONFUSION UNDERNEATH THE BARRIERS: participants were unaware of the differences between device types, so 'technology' is being evaluated as one undifferentiated thing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The sample is small and the paper says larger studies are needed before the findings generalise
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: RESPONSE BIAS IN A FOCUS GROUP IS NAMED BY THE AUTHORS: the enthusiasm reported should be read with caution because of the setting in which it was expressed
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Participants were naive tablet users by design, so the findings do not speak for experienced users
